title: Zesty Eastern Eggplant Delight
description: A flavorful, gluten-free dish that combines the sweetness of eggplant with the zesty flavors of the Middle East.
instructions: Cut the eggplant into 1/2-inch thick slices and brush with olive oil.
Season with salt and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
In a separate pan, heat the zesty harissa over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for an additional minute.
To assemble, place a layer of eggplant slices in the pie crust.
Top with a layer of the zesty harissa mixture, followed by crumbled feta cheese.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of feta cheese on top.
Bake for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.
